QUOTE: "Calls `client.createPost` once more. ... On failure, either removes the post (for the three terminal errors) or sets `failed: true` again."
VERDICT: HIT
WHY: The answer states retryFailedPost makes a single new createPost attempt (with noRetry/retryLimit 0, no loop or backoff) and on failure removes the post for the three errors or marks it failed again.
